messages:
Tessa (Sales): Quick one: HealthCore wants POC credits ASAP and asks for one DocuSign envelope with MSA + OF. Can we countersign OF now and hold MSA?
Marco (Legal): We can countersign OF if it explicitly references the MSA and states it does not modify it. Need to flag indemnity cap in their redline.
Lina (Finance): We can release POC credits on OF-only if OF contains pricing, term, and PO number. Standard Net30; Net45 needs approval.
Diego (SE): HealthCore requested HSM/BYOK in SQ. Hosted POC can't do BYOK. Dedicated/Private required and provisioning takes ~3 business days + SOW.
Noor (Security): We'll return SQ with SOC2 link. Add KMS options note: Redwood-managed keys (default) vs BYOK/HSM (requires Dedicated/Private and provisioning SOW).
Tessa (Sales): Plan: send OF-only with conditional clause: "POC access granted subject to execution of MSA; this OF does not modify the MSA." Add KMS checkbox and attach SOC2 + SQ answers.
Marco (Legal): Good. I'll add mutual indemnity cap language (fees in prior 12 months or $1M floor).
esign-bot: Envelope created env_20260322_03. Sent to customer; reminder 48h.
Tessa (Sales): Thanks team. I'll update thread after execution.
